Track 6 follow-up to `garment-thermal`: runs its two-node model against `pythermalcomfort` 4.6.1 over 108 conditions. Core temperature within 0.25 °C; skin temperature mean 0.58 °C apart (max 2.1 °C); evaporative loss up to 14 W/m². Compares two implementations, not either against measurements; causes of the gap untested. Tests pass (8), `python site/build.py` prints ok.
